results.rationale: This is a general disqualification clause rather than a verifiable bidder attribute, so no specific evidence is provided to demonstrate compliance.
We have at least two completed solar/renewable energy projects, but the required per-project contract value threshold from the RFP table (M1) is not provided, so value compliance cannot be confirmed.
ISO 9001 is explicitly listed as held in the company profile, satisfying the mandatory certification requirement.
Capability records show completed work for Federal and Provincial Government clients, and the company profile confirms serving these client types in Pakistan.
The company profile indicates the ability to arrange a bank guarantee/CDR via scheduled banks up to its facility limit, but does not confirm it will meet exactly 2% of the (unknown) bid price.
We have PMP-certified project managers, but no evidence provided confirms the assigned PM will have the required minimum eight years of infrastructure project experience.
The company profile states FBR NTN registration with active taxpayer (ATL) status, meeting the mandatory legal requirement.

No evidence is provided that the proposed PV modules will be Tier-1 with at least 21% efficiency and a 25-year linear performance warranty, as the capability records do not state module specifications or warranties.
